frontmatter.description: Design intelligence for law firms, attorneys & legal-tech. 82 legal product types (personal injury, criminal defense, family, immigration, estate planning, corporate, IP, tax, litigation firms + legal SaaS like case management & e-discovery), 82 color palettes, 42 font pairings, 25 chart types, 99 UX guidelines across 16 tech stacks (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Astro, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Nuxt, Nuxt UI, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Jetpack Compose, Three.js, Angular, Laravel). Actions: plan, build, create, design, implement, review, fix, improve, optimize UI/UX for legal websites & apps. Projects: law firm website, attorney landing page, free case evaluation, practice-area page, client intake, case-management dashboard, legal-tech SaaS, attorney directory, legal blog. Elements: button, modal, navbar, sidebar, card, table, form, chart, hero, testimonial. Styles: trust & authority, minimalism, editorial, glassmorphism, swiss modernism, data-dense, accessible. Topics: credibility, bar credentials, accessibility, color palette, typography, font pairing, conversion, consultation CTA, no-fee-unless-we-win.
